summary: Completed testing of Phase 1-3 features for Nevika Cura Healthcare Platform. Backend APIs 100% pass rate. Frontend features mostly working with one routing bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Route conflict - /order-tracking route defined twice in App.js (lines 304 and 370). First route (OrderTracking.js) takes precedence, making VirtualOrderTracking.jsx inaccessible

action_items: Fix duplicate /order-tracking route in App.js - change VirtualOrderTracking route to /virtual-tracking or remove duplicate at line 304
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has duplicate route for /order-tracking at lines 304 and 370 - first one wins, second is unreachable
seed_data_creation: Created subscription refills for phone 9999999999 during API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1-3 features tested. Backend APIs working. Frontend features verified: Diabetes Combo Deal banner (20% OFF), Auto Refill CTA, SubscriptionRefill modal (5 conditions, medicine selection, interval picker), Trust Badges (DL/FSSAI), Return & Refund Policy page (4 sections), Health Timeline page, Top Brand badges on medicine cards. VirtualOrderTracking page inaccessible due to route conflict.
